string.text: Don't hold a grudge, pal - your stuff went to a good cause.
And stay away from the boat park, or we'll tear your legs off and use 'em as toothpicks. Got it, chump?
Oh, and we left you a little something as a "way out" over there too. So don't go thinking we're savages, yeah?
This place is pretty damn good. Look at all these stalkers charging in here like flies to honey. I wonder what they’re after…
Yeah… Let’s grab the best stuff and get the hell outta here…
